title: Middle Eastern Shakshuka with Almonds
description: A flavorful twist on the traditional North African dish, with a crunchy almond garnish. This recipe combines the spices of the Middle East with the rich flavors of shakshuka.

ingredients.name: Middle eastern spice blend (or substitute with a mix of cumin, paprika, and coriander)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced almonds and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly toasted and fragrant.
Add the middle eastern spice blend and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the shakshuka and cook, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is heated through.
Make 4 wells in the shakshuka mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes, until the eggs are cooked through.
Sprinkle with parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional almonds if desired.
